name: Planar layer filling
summary: Rectangular and circular/annular planar coverage: perimeters, plus alternating-direction raster fill clipped to whichever boundary shape was requested.

evidence.label: EXPERIMENTAL
evidence.scope: Deterministic generator validated by schema, geometry-bounds, and golden-output tests. Not yet evidenced on physical hardware under this exact manifest and generator revision.

inputs.description: A request with a finite `outerDiameter`/`diameter`, or `geometry` set to "circle"/"annulus", resolves to a circular/annular perimeter with raster fill clipped to that boundary. Otherwise it resolves to a rectangular perimeter with raster fill clipped to `width`/`depth`. Either way the raster alternates direction by layer — see README.md.

validation.description: Every emitted point stays within the declared part envelope.
The number of distinct layer indices equals the requested layer count.
Every perimeter/ring/fill-ring path's first and last point coincide.
